subject.title: fix: skip stale label sync for newer review comments

question: Should OpenClaw accept the broader apply-lane guard that skips all open-PR label and comment mutation when the live durable review marker is newer than the stored report?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but it intentionally changes the automation mutation boundary and can leave labels temporarily stale while state catches up.

options.title: Accept conservative skip
options.body: Merge this branch and let newer durable review markers block stale report-driven label and comment mutation.

options.title: Require narrower mutation split
options.body: Ask for a targeted patch that suppresses only selected unsafe mutations while allowing some stale-label cleanup to continue.

options.title: Pause for more replay evidence
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers see additional production-shaped apply replay evidence across more stale-label scenarios.

recommendation.title: Accept conservative skip
recommendation.body: Merge this branch and let newer durable review markers block stale report-driven label and comment mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent current-main history in the affected apply-lane mutation boundary and authored the head-validation follow-up.
